Name: Quick Shot
Description: A rapid, light ranged attack.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A precise follow-up that can stagger the target.

Name: Venomous Shot
Description: An arrow tipped with poison that deals reduced but lingering damage.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Further increases damage and poison potency.
Coats the arrowhead twice, adding a second, stronger poison.

Name: Volley
Description: Fires a spread of arrows at all enemies.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Barbed arrowheads poison every target hit.

Name: Crippling Shot
Description: A shot aimed at a weak point that cripples the target.

Name: Eagle Eye
Description: Focuses the mind to sharpen aim for several turns. Grants no immediate damage.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Steadies your draw, also raising attack.

Name: Swift Strike
Description: A quick, precise attack that hits before the enemy can react.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Each strike quickens you, raising DEX.

Name: Mark Prey
Description: Marks the target, exploiting its weak points and lowering its defenses.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Marking prey also sharpens your aim.

Name: Snare
Description: Tangles the enemy with a snare, stunning it briefly.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A barbed snare that also poisons.

Name: Feral Slash
Description: A savage slash inspired by the fighting style of wild beasts, leaving a toxic wound.

Name: Hunter's Focus
Description: A patient, deliberate strike from careful observation of the prey.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Finds a gap in the target's guard, weakening its defense.

Name: Guard Strike
Description: A disciplined strike delivered from a defensive stance, reinforcing your guard.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Your guard also raises magic resistance.

Name: Holy Strike
Description: A righteous blow empowered by faith.

Name: Shield Wall
Description: Channels defensive energy to restore health and fortify your defenses.

Name: Challenge
Description: Issues a challenge that draws the enemy's focus while dealing damage.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Intimidates the target, weakening its attack.

Name: Crusader Strike
Description: A powerful forward strike that uses the full weight of your armor.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A righteous blow that briefly heals you.

Name: Heavy Blow
Description: A powerful melee strike that hits with full force, cracking the target's guard.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A crushing blow that can stun.

Name: Double Strike
Description: Two rapid hits on the same target.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The flurry also raises your attack.

Name: War Cry
Description: An intimidating battle cry that strikes fear and deals damage, bolstering your own strength.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Your cry also hardens your defense.

Name: Slam
Description: Drives the enemy back with a brutal show of raw force, stunning them briefly.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Also shatters the target's guard, weakening its defense.

Name: Battle Rush
Description: Charges at the enemy with reckless, forward momentum.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The rush also raises your STR.

Name: Berserk Blow
Description: A frenzied strike fueled by pure rage that fuels further aggression.

Name: Cleave
Description: A wide, sweeping swing that hits all enemies.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Sunders the armor of everything it hits.

Name: Battle Roar
Description: An earth-shaking roar that weakens the enemy's strength while raising your own attack.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The roar also throws off the target's aim.

Name: Reckless Strike
Description: An all-out attack with no regard for your own defense.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A reckless blow that can stun.

Name: Primal Fury
Description: Channels primal rage into a single devastating blow, greatly increasing your attack.

Name: Holy Light
Description: Calls down holy light to smite an enemy, silencing them with its radiance.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The light also briefly heals your allies.

Name: Minor Heal
Description: Channels divine energy to restore a meaningful amount of health to the caster or a friendly target.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Leaves lingering light that regenerates HP.

Name: Divine Protection
Description: Invokes divine power to shield a friendly target, bolstering their physical and magic defenses.

Name: Blessing
Description: Invokes a divine blessing on the caster or a friendly target, empowering their physical and magical attacks.

Name: Smite
Description: Calls down divine wrath on a single enemy, shattering their defenses.

Name: Quick Slash
Description: A fast slashing strike.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Slip away after striking, raising evasion.

Name: Backstab
Description: Strikes from an unexpected angle for high damage, fueling further aggression.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A strike from the shadows that can stun.

Name: Poison Dagger
Description: Coats your blade in toxins before delivering a damaging strike.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The venom also corrodes the target's defense.

Name: Evasive Strike
Description: Attacks while maneuvering out of the enemy's reach, improving your agility.

Name: Exploit Weakness
Description: Targets a gap in the enemy's guard, reducing their defense.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Leaves an open wound that poisons.

Name: Flame Bolt
Description: Hurls a bolt of fire that ignites a burning wound on the target.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Scorches the target, weakening its magic resistance.

Name: Frost Shard
Description: Launches a shard of ice that freezes the target in place.

Name: Spark
Description: Shocks the enemy with a bolt of lightning, disrupting their concentration.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The spark leaves an electric burn.

Name: Elemental Wave
Description: Releases a wave of mixed elemental energy that strikes all enemies.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Overloads every target, briefly silencing it.

Name: Mana Barrier
Description: Converts mana into a protective barrier, restoring health and bolstering defenses.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The barrier also raises magic resistance.

Name: Arcane Bolt
Description: Fires a bolt of pure arcane energy.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Converts part of the damage dealt into mana.

Name: Mana Drain
Description: Drains arcane energy from the target, dealing damage and replenishing your own mana.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Also unravels the target's magic resistance.

Name: Arcane Blast
Description: An explosion of arcane energy that strikes all enemies.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Disrupts every target, briefly silencing it.

Name: Void Spike
Description: Conjures a spike of void energy that pierces an enemy's magic resistance.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The void can lock the target in place, stunning it.

Name: Arcane Surge
Description: Channels raw arcane force into a devastating focused beam.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The surge also raises your magic attack.

Name: Thorn Lash
Description: Whips the enemy with thorned vines, inflicting a venomous wound.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Thorns can entangle the target, stunning it.

Name: Nature Bolt
Description: Fires a bolt of concentrated natural energy.

Name: Barkskin
Description: Hardens your skin like bark, restoring health and regenerating vitality.

Name: Wind Gust
Description: Calls upon the wind to sharpen the reflexes of all allies, increasing their agility.

Name: Nature's Healing
Description: Channels nature's restorative energy to heal a friendly target and grant ongoing regeneration.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The grove's embrace also raises magic resistance.

Name: Dark Slash
Description: A slash infused with dark energy that saps the target's fighting strength.

UpgradeOptions.Description: A hungering blade that heals you for part of the damage.

Name: Soul Drain
Description: Siphons life force from an enemy, healing the caster for the damage dealt.

Name: Dark Shield
Description: Surrounds yourself with dark energy, warding you against magic.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The shield also raises physical defense.

Name: Necrotic Strike
Description: A strike that corrupts the enemy's vitality, poisoning and weakening their defenses.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Feeds on the target, healing you for part of the damage.

Name: Shadow Veil
Description: Cloaks yourself in shadow to deliver a forceful, unseen strike.

UpgradeOptions.Description: The veil blinds the target, reducing its aim.

Name: Verdant Vigor
Description: Fills an ally with the strength of the wild, raising their maximum HP and MP by 5% for 60 minutes - in and out of fights. Can be cast outside of combat.

UpgradeOptions.Description: Raises max HP and MP a little more.
Further raises max HP and MP.
